prompt_md: A plane flies 1,200 km to a city and straight back at 400 km/h airspeed. A steady 100 km/h wind blows from the city all day. How many hours is the round trip?
prompt_short: 1,200 km out and back at 400 km/h with a 100 km/h wind. Hours?
explain_intuition_md: The tailwind seems to give back what the headwind took, but you spend longer fighting the headwind than enjoying the tailwind. Wind always makes a round trip slower.
